title: The pipe operator `|>` and its `_` placeholder (Pipe PL3-PL16, Chaining Study CS2) are not implemented
Deferred features are rejected with generic or wrong diagnostics, not structured unsupported diagnostics
Type-argument defaults, short explicit lists, and the declared `collect` default (Type-Argument Defaults TD1-TD7, Collect CO5) are not implemented
Method references `Type::name` and `value::name` (Method References MR1-MR4, MR6) are not implemented
The evening `let mut` follow-ups (2026-09-29, items 1, 2, and 4): parenthesized multi-name lists, the `mut-on-primitive` code, and the `redundant-let-mut` warning are not implemented

The closure-backed data `Iterator[T]` with a private `step`, `Iterator::from_fn`, `map` and `fold`, and `for` over `Iterable` only (Chaining Study CS7-CS11), are not implemented: the prototype keeps the `Iterator` trait
Bindings through supertraits (AT1) and trait value types that bind associated types (AT2) are not implemented
Embedding simplification cannot be fully exercised: the prototype compiles one module without trait imports, so trait availability is untested, and the fixtures need package roles
Visibility-aware member lookup cannot be exercised: the prototype compiles one module, so every own member is visible, and the fixtures need package roles
Generic `collect[C]` with `FromIterator` (Collect CO1-CO3, CO6) is not implemented
The evening operator follow-ups (2026-09-29, items 5 and 6): the panicking map read in `m[k] op= v` and the permission of a newtype unwrap are not implemented
Trait-argument ownership fixtures need the `Iterable` trait or package roles, which the prototype lacks
Entry-point cases use a private declaration in `pub fn main`, so they also report `private-type-leak`
Typed derivation M29's per-trait Self-line warning needs a second package, and the prototype CLI has no package roles
The `disposed-file` runtime profile named in spec/conformance/README.md does not exist
An initialization group's statements are not interleaved: the package linker joins the group's modules by identity, so a read of a later-joined module's binding fails
The prototype has no pack operations, so `pack.map(` on a local named `pack` resolves as a method call
A script's top-level println needs the inferred script entry requirement row, which the prototype does not infer
